niche_preference_profile: This user prefers light, airy, and polished app screens that feel complete and functional. They like layouts with clear section hierarchy, enough content to feel full, and obvious interaction patterns such as labeled rows, toggles, chevrons, and primary actions. They generally favor concise copy, strong visual balance, and modern but restrained styling over crowded, overly decorative, or unfinished-looking interfaces.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that are well-filled and balanced, with enough content to avoid large empty areas but not so much that the layout feels crowded.
Prefers clearly separated sections with strong visual hierarchy and organized grouping of related settings or content.
Prefers interfaces that show a fuller, more complete set of expected options and visible items rather than sparse or placeholder-like screens.
Prefers rows and controls that make interaction obvious, with consistent labels, chevrons, toggles, and clear affordances.
Prefers short, direct, easy-to-scan copy over verbose explanations or overly instructional text.
Prefers screens that feel refined, intentional, and fully built rather than rough, awkward, or placeholder-like.
Prefers straightforward list rows and stacked settings cards over boxed, nested, or overly decorative card groupings.
Prefers obvious navigation and action cues, including visible primary actions, clear drill-in rows, and minimal ambiguity about what can be tapped.
Prefers clean, modern styling with balanced spacing and tasteful color use, avoiding heavy, cluttered, or overly aggressive visual treatment.
